note: Set A's ten claims are all supported by the page (grade level 0'-0", finished floor 2'-9 1/2", and the 3/8"=1'-0" scales for sections C1/A1), though several are duplicate restatements of the same facts. Set B covers more ground (sheet number A-301, sheet title, per-module finished floor heights) but contains clear errors: it misreads the East Module finished floor as 2' 3 1/2" with a fabricated quote, and twice binds '116' to a lot number even though the text layer shows 'LOT NUMBER:' with no value and 116 only near the scale. Because B invents a value and a field binding while A makes no factual errors, A is the more faithful set despite its redundancy.
